messages:
liam: Quick heads-up — depot in SW region received a 12-unit H100 shipment from VendorX. Depot report says 3 units show crushed foam and only 1 set of photos attached. They won't accept the RMA without full photos.
vendor_linda: Sorry — we shipped with carrier TL-77. I asked the forwarder for proof of condition but haven't gotten all images. Attaching what I have now. https://s3.redwood.aws/vendorx/ship-1741234567/photos.zip
liam: got the link, thanks. depot still needs photos of serial plate + chassis for the 3 damaged units to generate the RMA labels. Without that we can't create inbound RMA in our system.
ops-bot: Ticket INC-4521 created: "rma-photos-missing" — assigned to @vendor_linda and @maria for follow-up.
maria: vendor, can you confirm if the packing list includes per-unit photos in their manifest? If forwarder can't supply, we can accept conditional intake (quarantine) but that triggers a per-unit inspection fee and extends SLA.
vendor_linda: packing manifest has a single collage photo. Forwarder says their checklist shows 12 ok at manifest time but they took batch pics only. Will push for per-unit closeups today.
alex: If we go quarantine/conditional intake we need to flag units in cluster-provisioning so no auto-deploy happens. Tag format: `sw-depot/quarantine/1741234567` — ops can run `redwood-inventory tag --id <serial> --tag quarantine`.
liam: also need to decide on acceptance economics: vendor contract covers DOA up to 2 units, beyond that vendor cover depends on proof. We should request depot to waive inspection fee pending photos, otherwise ops will bill to VendorX. vendor_linda?
vendor_linda: understood. I'll request the waiver. If forwarder can't produce images we can offer 50% credit on inspection fees for this incident but need to confirm liability with logistics team.
customs_svc: FYI — these H100s cleared with HS 8471.80, no customs delay. If units sit in quarantine >7 days new duties process may apply.
maria: ok — temporary plan: 1) vendor to push per-unit photos by EOD (1741235120). 2) If not received, depot to intake under quarantine and ops to bill vendor for inspection unless waiver approved. 3) Create RMA placeholders so we can allocate replacement pool.
vendor_linda: pushing now. I'll post updates in this thread when forwarder responds.
liam: thanks. if you need a template for acceptable photos: front-left chassis, serial plate closeup, foam/box wide shot, and packing slip next to unit. Small example:```
serial_check: grep "SN" manifest.csv | sed -n '1,4p'
```
vendor_linda: got it — sending checklist to forwarder.
ops-bot: Reminder — SLA exception requested by @liam; routing to LogisticsOps for approval.
